column1: # ACTION IR cross-pass baseline. p166 could NOT measure a multi-hour interval: the pass itself is ~40-60 min.
# The NEXT pass must diff its own ls-remote sweep against the p166_t0_sha column below and against p166_t0_utc.
# INTERVAL LEDGER (all measured by git ls-remote, the primary channel)
# p164_sweep -> p165_sweep   37 min   1 of 12 changed (ai-shifu only)        [T173]
# p165_sweep -> p166_t1      52 min   0 of 12 changed  (two independent sweeps)
# INSTRUMENT FAULT caught before publication: the first t0 capture wrote repo and sha on
# ALTERNATING lines (git ls-remote --symref emits "ref:" and the sha as separate records).
# A naive $1/$2 parse of that file reported 12 of 12 changed. Re-parsed with
# awk '$2=="ref:"{r=$1;next} r!=""{print r"\t"$1;r=""}' the true answer is 0 of 12.
